name: Add message-to-subtask conversion feature
description:
# Conversation Summary

1. **Feature Request**: Added a new icon/button to ChatEntry's floating toolbar that converts a chat message into a subtask with the message content.

2. **Implementation Approach**: Modified two components - ChatEntry.vue handles the UI button and emits the conversion event, while Chat.vue processes the event and creates the subtask.

3. **Subtask Creation**: The converted subtask uses the first line of the message as its title and includes the full message content as the description, inheriting files from the original message.

4. **Message Removal**: After successful subtask creation, the original message is automatically deleted from the chat, keeping the interface clean.

5. **User Feedback**: The feature includes success/error notifications to confirm the conversion outcome and uses a warning icon to indicate the destructive action of message removal.

Add the handler method ```vue src/components/ChatEntry.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `emits` array | Added `'convert-to-subtask'` event | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | More dropdown menu | Added "To subtask" option with warning icon | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `methods` | Added `convertMessageToSubtask()` method | Now let's update Chat.vue to handle the convert-to-subtask event: ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/chat/Chat.vue ``` Now I'll update Chat.vue to add the listener for the `convert-to-subtask` event in the ChatMessageList and implement the handler: ```vue src/components/chat/Chat.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` | Modify | ChatMessageList event listener | Added `@convert-to-subtask="onConvertMessageToSubtask"` | | `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` | Modify | `methods` | Added `onConvertMessageToSubtask()` method to handle message-to-subtask conversion and removal | ## Summary I've successfully added the feature to convert a message into a subtask with automatic removal of the parent message.
